name: fee-optimizer-mcp
description: MCP server that compares crypto exchange trading fees (Binance, OKX, Gate.io, Bybit, MEXC, Bitget, KuCoin, Kraken, Coinbase, Hyperliquid, BingX, Phemex, BloFin, Bitstamp, Bitvavo, Finst, Bitpanda and BISON) with full VIP tiers, token discounts (BNB/OKB/GT/MX/BGB/KCS/HYPE/PT; Kraken, Coinbase, BingX and BloFin have no native token; Hyperliquid uses a staked-HYPE discount ladder), Gate GT / KuCoin KCS holding-based qualification (tokenBalance), asset-based qualification (accountAssetsUsd for OKX/Bybit/Bitget, Kraken assets-on-platform AOP unified Tier/Pro levels, BingX VIP Club asset track with volume-only Elite/Supreme rungs, and BloFin three-track OR volume/spot-volume/assets qualification with $50k-assets futures VIP1 and a non-API-volume rule at VIP4+), KuCoin spot Class A/B/C fee groups, Kraken 17-tier unified ladder with futures maker rebates from Tier 11, Coinbase Advanced Trade spot-only volume tiers, Hyperliquid 14-day rolling volume tiers with hourly funding settlement (first DEX venue, USDC margin), BingX per-product spot/futures VIP Club ladders with a volume-only Elite rung and 8h funding, Phemex 7-tier ladders with 0.01% base futures maker and flat 20% PT fee deduction, BloFin 6-tier derivatives-led ladders (0.020%/0.060% futures base) with 8h funding, no token and no direct fiat rails, Bitstamp (founded 2011, Luxembourg, Robinhood-owned; MiCA CASP + NYDFS BitLicense + UK FCA + SG MAS) 11-tier volume-only spot ladder (0.30%/0.40% entry to 0.00%/0.03% at $1B) plus regulated USD-margined perps at a flat -0.005% maker rebate / 0.015% taker with 8h P2P funding, modeled with a venue×country PRODUCT gate using a POSITIVE region allowlist (perps open only to the 30 EEA states — EU27 + Iceland/Liechtenstein/Norway; every other supplied residency, incl. US/GB/CA/JP/SG/HK/TH/AU/BR/CH, is product-blocked while spot stays open everywhere the venue serves), deep direct fiat rails (free US ACH both ways, free SEPA in / EUR 3 out, 0.05% in / 0.1% out international SWIFT with floors/cap, ~4% card) and BTC 0.0005 / ERC-20-only USDT ~20 withdrawals, maker/taker weighted rates, funding, withdrawal, spread and slippage costs, fiat deposit/cash-out fees across direct card and bank rails (card/ACH/SEPA/FPS/PIX/wire/SWIFT in USD/EUR/GBP/BRL via get_fiat_cost, with residency-aware rail filtering, net received amount, ETA and cheapest-venue ranking), savings calculations, total-cost comparison, annualized all-in cost with tier upgrade savings (calculate_annual_cost), and personalized exchange recommendations. get_funding_rates and the four cost tools support fundingMode=live to fetch the current real-time funding rate per venue via ccxt (per-exchange failure falls back to the bundled average, results tagged funding_source/funding_rate_ts). get_execution_cost and tradeSizeUsd/spreadMode/spreadPair/side on the four cost tools price bid-ask spread crossing plus order-book depth slippage: bundled typical-spread baselines by venue and pair class, or live top-100 VWAP book walks (failures fall back to bundled baselines listed in failures; shallow books keep measured cost with warnings).  Includes data provenance via get_data_sources and country-based compliance filtering (BloFin blocked US/CA/CN/SG and EEA under MiCA; Bitstamp venue-blocked in CN and its perps are product-gated outside EU/EEA while spot remains open). v0.41 enforces the post-cliff MiCA regime after the Article 143(3) transitional period ended on 2026-07-01: Binance, MEXC, Bitget, KuCoin, BingX, Phemex and BloFin are venue-blocked EEA-WIDE (all 30 EEA states, every product) through negative region_blocked gates — they hold no usable CASP authorization (withdrawn/pending applications or an active commencement-of-business ban, e.g. Binance's HCMC Greece withdrawal and KuCoin's FMA Austria bar) — while OKX/Gate (MFSA Malta), Bybit (FMA Austria), Kraken (CBI Ireland), Coinbase and Bitstamp (CSSF Luxembourg) remain onboardable; Bybit and Gate perps are additionally product_region_blocked EEA-wide pending MiFID II investment-firm authorization, so the EEA perp stack is OKX (X-Perps), Kraken and Bitstamp plus the non-custodial Hyperliquid book (no frontend geo-block; deliberately retained with risk caveats). Negative region gates only narrow EEA results and leave every non-EEA market (US/GB/AU/BR/JP/SG/HK/…) untouched. v0.42 adds Bitvavo as the 15th venue — the largest home-grown euro spot exchange (Amsterdam, founded 2018; AFM MiCA CASP #41000010, EEA passport; ~half of global EUR-denominated spot volume) — with a NEW venue-level POSITIVE region_allowed gate: it serves ONLY the 30 EEA states and is venue-blocked for every other residency (incl. default-key AU/BR/CH and the separately-operated GB/CH entities, which are not modeled); Bitvavo is SPOT-ONLY with a nine-rung single-track 30d EUR-volume PRO ladder (0.15%/0.25% base to 0.00%/0.02% above €25M, no token/assets track), the tightest EU EUR-book spread in the model (1.0 bps full / 0.5 crossing, Kaiko 2026-05), FREE SEPA both legs (iDEAL/Bancontact; €25k/day out) plus ~1% EU card deposit with no card cash-out, and BTC-only dynamic withdrawal modeled at 0.00005 BTC (no Lightning; stablecoins/alts unsupported), bringing the EEA spot stack to 8 venues while futures stays OKX/Kraken/Bitstamp/Hyperliquid (a futures persona sees Bitvavo as product-unsupported); account-fee lookup covered on spot. v0.43 adds Finst as the 16th venue — an Amsterdam SMART-ORDER-ROUTING BROKERAGE (ex-DEGIRO team, founded 2022; AFM MiCA CASP #41000015, EEA passport, ~30 countries/110k users) rather than an order-book exchange: a FLAT 0.15% on every buy/sell/swap with no maker/taker split, no volume tiers and no spread markup (external liquidity aggregated by SOR), modeled as a single-rung volume-independent ladder with a 1.0/0.5 bps cohort spread proxy; it is EEA-ONLY via the same venue-level region_allowed gate as Bitvavo (brings the EEA spot stack to 9 venues; vanishes from every non-EEA result), SPOT-ONLY (a futures persona sees Finst as unsupported_product inside the EEA and blocked outside), offers FREE SEPA/iDEAL/Bancontact/instant-SEPA both ways with NO card/PayPal and no USD/GBP, and models BTC withdrawal at 0.000085 BTC (dynamic network fee ≈0.00005 BTC plus a flat €2.50 third-party charge, folded into the native fee because the schema carries no surcharge field; the other 400+ markets are unmodeled); Finst exposes no public trading API and ccxt ships no connector, so get_account_fee_tier is unsupported for it (live account coverage stays 13 venues). v0.44 adds Bitpanda as the 17th venue — the first SPREAD-MODEL BROKERAGE (Vienna, founded 2014, 7.4M users; BaFin MiCA CASP 2025-01-27 with EEA30 passport + Austrian FMA license + UK FCA entity): the consumer app quotes an all-in price with the fee EMBEDDED as a markup and no separate commission, modeled with pricing_model=spread (no maker/taker, no ladder) — 1.49% per side headline, 0.99% BTC/stablecoin pairs via pair overrides, 2.49% sub-€100M small caps (index 1.99% and 10x margin unmodeled; futures unsupported); the spread baseline is pinned to 0 bps to avoid double-counting the embedded markup, and an execution_quality block discloses advertised 2.98% round trip vs TUM real-money measured 6.23% (4.25pp hidden; Frankfurt School 2026-03 replication, 432 RT/9 platforms); it serves ONLY EEA30 + GB via region_allowed (GB as a single-member region key), blocked for US/CA/CN/CH and all other residencies (EEA spot stack becomes 10; futures persona sees unsupported_product; the separate Fusion pro exchange and stocks/metals are not modeled); ALL fiat rails free since 2026 — SEPA/instant, deposit-only Visa/MC cards, PayPal, Apple/Google Pay in EUR and FPS+cards in GBP, no USD route (row retained with available:false); withdrawals pass dynamic network fees through at BTC 0.00000598 (~$0.46) and ETH 0.0006 (~$1.51); no referral and no ccxt class, so get_account_fee_tier is unsupported (coverage 13 of 17 venues). v0.45 adds BISON as the 18th venue — the second SPREAD-MODEL BROKERAGE (Boerse Stuttgart Group, Stuttgart, launched 2019, 1M+ active users; EUWAX AG quotes as principal for ~10s, no order book; Boerse Stuttgart Digital Custody held the FIRST BaFin MiCA custody/transfer license from 2025-01-17, EUWAX exchange service authorized 2025-04-01): all-in pricing_model=spread (no maker/taker, no ladder) — 1.25% per side BTC/ETH via pair overrides, 1.75% per side every other coin (~2.5% vs ~3.5% round trip), undercutting Bitpanda's 1.49% headline; spread baseline pinned to 0 bps against double-counting; an execution_quality block shows advertised 2.5% vs TUM real-money measured 2.58% (only ~0.08pp undisclosed; Oct-Nov 2025, six MiCA platforms) — the closest published-vs-measured alignment of the tested field (Bitvavo next; Bitpanda 6.23%, Coinbase 7.49%); it serves EEA30 + Switzerland via region_allowed (CH as a NEW single-member region key; active marketing DE/AT/CH) and is venue-blocked for GB — the complementary gap to Bitpanda (EEA+GB) — plus US/CA/JP/SG/AU/BR/CN/KR (EEA spot stack becomes 11, CH stack 15; futures persona sees unsupported_product; no futures/margin exist); crypto withdrawals are officially FREE with the group absorbing network costs (unlike Bitpanda pass-through), modeled at BTC 0 and ETH 0 — the globally cheapest modeled withdrawal for both (min 0.001 BTC, no Lightning/Taproot; ETH mainnet only, min 0.01, no L2); EUR-only fiat: FREE SEPA/SEPA Instant both legs including Swiss users, plus 2.49% deposit-only card/Apple Pay/Google Pay (no card cash-out, no GBP/USD/CHF rail; USD row retained available:false); €1.99 German stock/ETF orders and the 27% staking commission are not modeled; invite-a-friend has no affiliate URL and ccxt 4.5.78 ships no bison/euwax class, so get_account_fee_tier is unsupported (coverage 13 of 18 venues). v0.46 adds get_stablecoin_access as the 18th tool — MiCA stablecoin REGIONAL access intelligence: Tether never applied for MiCA EMT authorization and, after the CASP transition cliff on 2026-07-01 (ESMA75-113276571-1679, no extension), USDT venue trading is unavailable across all 30 EEA states (Coinbase 2024-12, Crypto.com 2025-01, Binance/Kraken/OKX/Gate/Bitstamp/Bitpanda/Bitvavo wave through 2025-03, Revolut ended buying 2026-07-06 and converts residuals 2026-08-31); the restriction binds VENUES not people — personal holding and on-chain withdrawal to self-custody remain legal, most venues retain custody/withdrawal/Convert, DEXs are outside the perimeter, and MEXC/Bitget/KuCoin/BingX/Phemex/BloFin are venue_blocked regardless; modeled MiCA-authorized alternatives are USDC/EURC (Circle France EMI), EURI (Banking Circle), EURCV (SocGen FORGE) and USDQ/EURQ (Quantoz; Bybit EU quote coins); per-venue rows carry delisted/never_offered/venue_blocked status with dates, eea/global scope and the venue's own availability in the country (CH/GB deliberately outside the EEA region); the same STABLECOIN_UNAVAILABLE_IN_REGION warning is auto-injected into compare_exchange_fees, calculate_savings, compare_total_cost, calculate_annual_cost and recommend_exchange (USDT-quoted pairs + EEA residency), get_withdrawal_fees (withdrawal/self-custody context), get_execution_cost and analyze_persona (5 of 7 personas habitually withdraw USDT). v0.47 adds compare_interface_costs as the 19th tool — CONSUMER vs PRO dual-interface cost modeling on the SAME account: the Kraken app (Instant Buy + custom-order surcharges), Coinbase Simple, Bitstamp Basic, Bitvavo Basic one-tap and the Bitpanda/BISON spread brokerages are compared against each venue's own PRO order-book benchmark using the TUM real-money €100 round-trip study (2025-10..11, six MiCA-licensed EU platforms; independently replicated by Frankfurt School 2026-03, 432 round-trips/9 platforms) — retail round-trips span 13x: Bitvavo 0.58% (pass-through, transparency benchmark) < BISON 2.58% < Kraken app 5.81% (3.81pp hidden) < Bitpanda 6.23% (4.25pp hidden) < Coinbase Simple 7.49% (4.51pp hidden, worst; the $2.99 flat fee dominates small DCA buys and even simple LIMIT orders carry a 1% execution fee); per-venue rows carry the consumer product name and fee model, a modeled one-way all-in cost, the measured round-trip, hidden markup pp, the PRO maker/taker base, the gap in pp and — with monthly_volume_usd — the annualized excess of staying on the consumer app instead of PRO (e.g. Coinbase at $1k/mo ≈ $168/yr), plus subscription caveats (Kraken+ $4.99/10k waiver, Coinbase One) and the fact that app volume earns NO PRO tier credit; Bitpanda/BISON have no separate PRO interface (the premium IS the fee), Bitstamp Basic is flagged unverified (no third-party measurement), residency gating applies (Bitvavo/Bitpanda/BISON blocked outside their service areas), and the same gap is auto-injected as consumer_interface hints into compare_exchange_fees/calculate_savings/compare_total_cost/recommend_exchange rows and as CONSUMER_INTERFACE_MORE_EXPENSIVE warnings on savings/recommendation results. v0.40 replaces the negative-list product gate with POSITIVE region allowlists (regions + product_region_gates): Bitstamp perps require EEA residency (all 30 EEA states supported), so unmodeled non-EEA countries like AU/BR/CH/TR/KR are no longer over-opened by the default key. v0.39 adds get_account_fee_tier: a READ-ONLY API-key authenticated lookup of the account's ACTUAL maker/taker fee (13 of 18 venues: Binance, OKX, Gate, Bybit, MEXC, Bitget, KuCoin spot+futures, Kraken spot+futures, Coinbase spot, Hyperliquid via public wallet address, BingX, Bitstamp spot, Bitvavo spot; Phemex and BloFin unsupported by the ccxt connector, Finst, Bitpanda and Bison have no public API/ccxt class, and Bitstamp/Bitvavo perps are not modeled), compared in bps against the public VIP schedule at the stated monthly volume; credentials are per-request only, never cached, never logged (audit logs redacted), compliance/product gates run before the authenticated call. tools.name: compare_exchange_fees
tools.description: Compare spot/futures maker & taker fees across eighteen exchanges with VIP tier resolution including BNB/GT/KCS holding gates (tokenBalance), OKX/Bybit/Bitget/BingX/BloFin asset qualification and Kraken AOP qualification (accountAssetsUsd; BingX Elite/Supreme rungs are volume-only and unreachable via assets; BloFin VIP4+ also requires non-API volume), KuCoin spot Class A/B/C groups, Kraken futures maker rebates, Coinbase Advanced spot-only volume tiers (excluded from futures comparisons), Hyperliquid 14-day rolling volume tiers with staked-HYPE multiplicative discount, BingX VIP Club ladders with volume-only Elite rung, Phemex 0.01% base futures maker, BloFin derivatives-led 6-tier ladder, token and referral discounts (referral optional per exchange), and optional maker/taker weighting. Requires ISO country code.

tools.name: get_referral_link
tools.description: Return the fee-discount referral/registration link for a specific exchange, with compliance filtering by country.

tools.name: calculate_savings
tools.description: Calculate original vs discounted trading fees and total savings for a monthly volume, including token discount (with Gate GT holding tiers via tokenBalance), VIP holding-gate downgrades, maker/taker weighting, funding cost, and display currency conversion.

tools.name: compare_total_cost
tools.description: Rank exchanges by all-in cost: trading fee (with VIP holding gates) plus futures funding cost plus network withdrawal fee, in the requested display currency.

tools.name: recommend_exchange
tools.description: Personalized exchange recommendation scored 0-100 from weighted fees, token holdings/discounts and funding cost, with reasons, tier holding warnings, tradeoffs, ranked alternatives, and actionable registration advice.

tools.name: get_data_sources
tools.description: Return data freshness (last_verified) and source URLs/caveats for every bundled data file. Use when users ask where fee numbers come from or how fresh they are.

tools.name: calculate_annual_cost
tools.description: Annualized all-in cost for one exchange: 12x trading fees at the resolved VIP tier, 12x futures funding exposure, and withdrawal fees times yearly count, plus a next-VIP-tier upgrade quote showing qualification path (volume, OKX/Bybit/Bitget/Kraken account assets (Kraken AOP), Gate GT, KuCoin KCS, or Binance BNB) and estimated annual saving. Pass fundingMode=live to annualize the current real-time funding rate instead of the bundled average.

tools.name: get_funding_rates
tools.description: Return per-exchange perpetual funding rate and settlement interval for a pair (default BTC/USDT). fundingMode=bundled (default) returns offline long-run averages; fundingMode=live fetches real-time current rates venue-by-venue via ccxt, with per-exchange fallback to bundled values on failure (listed in failures) and source/timestamp provenance on every row. Optional exchange list and country compliance filter.

tools.name: get_execution_cost
tools.description: Return per-exchange one-way taker execution cost in bps and USD for a specific order size (default $10,000): full spread, half-spread crossing, order-book depth-walk slippage, total cost, levels consumed and fill status. spreadMode=bundled (default) uses offline typical-spread baselines by venue and pair class (majors/large-cap/mid-alt); spreadMode=live fetches the real top-100 order book per venue via ccxt and VWAP-walks it for buy/sell on spot or futures, with per-exchange bundled fallback on failure (failures) and warnings for insufficient visible depth. Optional exchange list and country compliance filter.

tools.name: get_fiat_cost
tools.description: Return per-exchange fiat deposit or cash-out cost for an amount in USD/EUR/GBP/BRL across direct exchange-operated rails (card, ACH, SEPA, FPS, PIX, domestic wire, SWIFT): per-rail fee in fiat and USD, effective percent, net amount arriving, ETA and notes, with residency-aware region filtering (pass country), cheapest overall pick and saving vs the most expensive supported venue. Direct rails only; third-party gateway and P2P quotes are excluded and flagged.

tools.name: get_withdrawal_fees
tools.description: Compare crypto withdrawal (network) fees for an asset across all eighteen exchanges and supported chains (TRC-20, ERC-20, BEP20, Arbitrum, Optimism, Base, Polygon, Avalanche C, Solana, TON, AssetHub and native chains): fee in native units and USD from a dated price snapshot, suspended-wallet flags, cheapest open route per venue, best venue overall and saving vs worst. Covers 16 assets (BTC, ETH, USDT, USDC, SOL, XRP, DOGE, LTC, TRX, ADA, AVAX, DOT, LINK, BCH, TON, POL; Coinbase lists BTC/ETH/USDT/USDC as dynamic network-fee estimates; BloFin lists BTC/ETH/USDT/USDC with dynamic pass-through and TRC-20 at ~1); accepts network aliases, optional exchange list and country compliance filter.

tools.name: analyze_persona
tools.description: One-shot scenario recommendation for one of 7 research-anchored trader personas (casual buyer, DCA HODLer, active spot, swing futures, day scalper, VIP/institutional, no-KYC on-chain): runs the full annual all-in stack (trading fees + funding + spread + withdrawals + fiat rails) across every venue allowed in the country and returns ranked table, cost mix, component leaders, winner and persona-specific advice. Every preset parameter is overridable; unsupported legs are flagged, never zeroed.

tools.name: compare_personas
tools.description: Run ALL seven trader personas for a country in one call: per-persona winner plus realistic best_complete pick (venues missing fiat/withdrawal rails are demoted), a persona x venue annual-cost matrix, cross-persona venue win counts and the single most versatile venue. Optional persona subset, global token toggle and live funding/depth overrides. format=markdown|csv|both additionally returns a ready-to-paste rendered table in `rendered` (v0.36).

tools.name: analyze_token_discount
tools.description: Native-token fee-discount payback analysis: annual fee without vs with the platform token (BNB/MX/BGB/GT/KCS/HYPE/PT), USD saving, locked-capital opportunity cost, payback months and the max one-year token price drop it can absorb; without tokenBalance returns every achievable tier with a best-payback recommendation. Venues with no token toggle are reported honestly.

tools.name: volume_what_if
tools.description: Volume what-if/sensitivity sweep for spot or futures: per monthly-volume point (default: the union of all venues' VIP tier thresholds) returns the cross-venue cheapest ranking plus each venue's tier/maker/taker/weighted/annual-fee curve and an exact tier-crossing list; with baseVolume, reports each venue's next rung, extra monthly volume needed and USD/year saved at today's volume (rungs unreachable by volume alone, e.g. Binance spot BNB AND-gate, are flagged blocked_by_holding_gate). Applies referral and optional platform-token discounts; trading fees only. format=markdown|csv|both renders the sweep table in `rendered`; tableMetric=weighted_fee_pct|annual_fee_usd|tier selects the cell metric (v0.36).

tools.name: compare_countries
tools.description: Run ONE trader persona through the full annual all-in stack (trading fees + funding + spread + withdrawals + fiat rails) across multiple countries: per-country headline winner and realistic all-legs best_complete, annual cost and the extra vs the cheapest country (comparable basis, USD and %), compliance-blocked venues versus product-unsupported venues (e.g. spot-only Coinbase for futures), a venue×country availability matrix, cross-country venue win counts, cheapest/costliest country and the annual gap. Defaults to active_spot_trader over US/GB/DE/JP/SG/BR/CN; any of the 7 personas and up to 12 countries. format=markdown|csv|both renders the venue×country table in `rendered`; tableMetric=availability|cost selects status symbols or annual costs (v0.36).

tools.name: get_account_fee_tier
tools.description: Fetch the account's ACTUAL authenticated maker/taker fee with a READ-ONLY API key (apiKey+secret; OKX/KuCoin-Futures passphrase as password; Hyperliquid uses the public 0x wallet address only) and compare it in bps against the bundled public VIP schedule at the given monthly volume. 13/18 venues supported via ccxt (Phemex and BloFin return ACCOUNT_FEES_UNSUPPORTED, Finst, Bitpanda and Bison have no public API/ccxt class, as do Bitstamp and Bitvavo perps since both are spot-only); credentials are per-request only, never cached or logged; COUNTRY_BLOCKED/PRODUCT_BLOCKED_IN_COUNTRY gates run before any authenticated call; auth/network failures return typed, credential-scrubbed errors (v0.39).

tools.name: get_stablecoin_access
tools.description: Report MiCA regional access for a stablecoin (default USDT; also USDC/EURC/EURI/EURCV/USDQ/EURQ): issuer and MiCA EMT authorization, whether venue trading is barred in the resident's region (USDT unavailable at all 30 EEA venues after the 2026-07-01 CASP cliff; CH/GB outside the EEA region), custody/withdrawal and self-custody rights (holding and on-chain withdrawal stay legal — the restriction binds venues, not people), per-venue status (delisted with date / never_offered / venue_blocked, scope eea vs global, venue availability in the country), compliant alternatives and localized advice. The same STABLECOIN_UNAVAILABLE_IN_REGION warning is auto-injected into the fee, withdrawal, execution-cost and persona tools for USDT-quoted requests from EEA residents (v0.46).

tools.name: compare_interface_costs
tools.description: Compare each venue's CONSUMER interface (Kraken app Instant Buy/custom orders, Coinbase Simple, Bitstamp Basic, Bitvavo Basic one-tap, Bitpanda/BISON spread-model brokerage) against its own PRO order-book benchmark on the same account. Evidence: TUM real-money €100 round-trip study (2025-10..11, six MiCA-licensed EU platforms), replicated by Frankfurt School (432 round-trips, 2026-03) — retail round-trips span 13x: Bitvavo 0.58% (pass-through, transparency benchmark) < BISON 2.58% < Kraken app 5.81% (3.81pp hidden) < Bitpanda 6.23% (4.25pp hidden) < Coinbase Simple 7.49% (4.51pp hidden, worst; $2.99 flat fee dominates small DCA buys, simple LIMIT orders still carry a 1% execution fee). Returns per venue: consumer product name + fee model, modeled one-way all-in cost, measured round-trip, hidden markup pp, PRO maker/taker base, gap in pp and — with monthly_volume_usd — the annualized excess of the consumer app vs PRO (Coinbase at $1k/mo ≈ $168/yr); subscription caveats (Kraken+ $4.99/10k waiver, Coinbase One) and app volume earns NO PRO tier credit; Bitpanda/BISON have no separate PRO interface (the premium IS the fee), Bitstamp Basic flagged unverified; country applies residency gating; the same gap auto-injects as consumer_interface hints and CONSUMER_INTERFACE_MORE_EXPENSIVE warnings into the fee/savings/total-cost/recommendation tools (v0.47).
